meta.title: WSL Workspaces
meta.description: Choose a WSL distribution and Linux directory, then open its independent Harness backend in your browser.

setupNotice: First use: manually install the dedicated Harness runtime inside your chosen WSL distribution before preparing a workspace. Installing this plugin does not install that runtime. Windows folders need no WSL setup.
title: Choose workspace environment
notice: WSL workspaces open in a separate browser tab with an independent Linux backend. Existing Windows sessions are not moved. Configure your model in that backend if needed.
noDistros: No WSL distributions found. Install a distribution, then retry.
truncated: Only part of this directory is shown. Enter an exact path to continue.
ready: Workspace ready. Open the authenticated link below in your browser.
invalidUrl: The backend returned an unsafe URL. Only loopback HTTP(S) links are accepted.
invalidPath: Enter an absolute Linux directory beginning with /.
busy: The workspace is being adopted. Please wait.
stopNotice: Closing this dialog cancels the request, but does not stop a backend already started.
